blocks.text: leaving for a battle, he announced, "None who has caused harm to his neighbour should accompany us today." Someone asked, "I urinated at the base of my neighbour's wall." "You will then not accompany us today," Rasulullaah ﷺ instructed.[^1]
The Amplified Severity of Committing Adultery with one's Neighbour's Wife and of Stealing from him

Hadhrat Miqdaad bin Aswad (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once asked the Sahabah (RA), "What do you think of adultery?" They replied, "It is Haraam. Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ have forbidden it and it will remain Haraam until the Day of Qiyaamah." Rasulullaah ﷺ then said to them, "The sin of committing adultery with ten women is less severe than that of committing adultery with the neighbour's wife." Rasulullaah ﷺ the asked, "What do you think of stealing?" They replied, "Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ have forbidden it and it is therefore Haraam." Rasulullaah ﷺ then said to them, "The sin of stealing from ten homes is less severe than that of stealing from the neighbour's house."[^2]
The Narration of Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) Stating that Allaah Loves Three Persons and Detests Three Persons

Hadhrat Mutarrif bin Abdullaah (RA) says, "I had always been hearing a Hadith narrated by Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) and desired to meet him (to hear the Hadith directly from him). Therefore, when I eventually met Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) one day, I said to him, 'O Abu Dharr! I have been hearing a Hadith that you narrate and have always wished to meet you.' He exclaimed, 'May Allaah bless your father! You have now met me, so come (tell me which Hadith it is).' I replied, 'The Hadith I heard was that Rasulullaah ﷺ once told you that Allaah loves three persons and detests three persons.'
Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) remarked, 'It never even occurs to me to lie about what Rasulullaah ﷺ said.' I asked, 'Who then are the three persons whom Allaah loves?' He replied, 'The man who strives in the path of Allaah with steadfastness, expecting rewards only from Allaah and then fights until he is martyred. You find mention of him in Allaah's Book that is with you.' He then recited the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: إِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِيْنَ يُقَاتِلُوْنَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِهٖ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُمْ بُنْيَانٌ مَّرْصُوْصٌ
blocks.text: Verily Allaah loves those (Mu'mineen) who fight (the enemies of Islaam) in His path (standing) in rows (in front of the enemy with
